Are you interested in leveraging your experience to help AI models better understand what effective management and decision-making look like? Join 10x Team and play a key role in shaping advanced AI systems by sharing your real-world insights—all on your own schedule. We’re seeking senior-level professionals based in the EU or UK to help ensure our AI-generated outputs are grounded in practical, actionable, and industry-relevant solutions. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation. You’ll build sophisticated, intuitive user experiences while working across AI models, agentic workflows, and all parts of web infrastructure to ship complete products. Our venture capital strategy backs exceptional founders at the earliest stage, often before an idea is fully formed, often providing the first institutional capital and an unmatched degree of strategic healthcare-specific leverage through exit. The platform combines Redesign’s healthcare company-building methodology with something no standalone venture firm can offer: Cedars-Sinai’s 4,500+ physicians and nurses, its expansive clinical network of 40+ hospitals and sites of care, a purpose-built synthetic and de-identified data platform, and a standing commitment to serve as the first customer for every company the platform creates. Ideas originate from the clinicians and researchers who see problems up close every day. You will have something almost no one in a healthcare venture has: a fully committed institutional partner with world-class clinical expertise, deep data assets, and the infrastructure to pilot and validate at scale - all before a company writes its first check to a customer. The access is real. The commitment is structural, not performative. For the full list of exclusive benefits as part of the Redesign Health and Cedars-Sinai partnership, explore the article here https://www.cedars-sinai.org/digital-innovation-platform.html. You will build the competitive landscapes and market analyses that separate real opportunities from noise, and help turn that work into investment theses the team can act on. Our job is to evaluate and identify the right opportunities for venture creation and/or scaling while directing other solutions to the proper channel within the Cedars-Sinai organization. You will continue to develop the infrastructure that lets us do this repeatedly and you will spend real time in the local innovation community, building the relationships with investors and founders. This is a strong role for someone early in their career who wants to get exposure to venture at the heart of where healthcare is delivered through a truly unique partnership. You will work directly with New Ventures and Cedars-Sinai leadership, help turn thematic research into opportunities to fund companies, and have access to clinical and institutional partners.
